components.name: Sticker
components.description: The 'you are here' state: ink fill, white die-cut ring, soft lift, hand-cut corners, −1.5° tilt.
components.css: .ds-sticker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 5px 11px; background: #141414; color: #fff; font: 700 13px 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 10px 13px 9px 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,20,.16), 0 5px 12px -3px rgba(20,20,20,.16); transform: rotate(-1.5deg); }

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: Primary add action (+ New, To-do +): ink fill, white glyph.
components.css: .ds-ink { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #141414; color: #fff; font: 700 12.5px 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: default; }

components.name: Button
components.description: Storage-style button: card fill, inset hairline ring; danger variant in red; armed = solid red confirm.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn">Preview</button> <button class="ds-btn danger">Move to trash</button> <button class="ds-btn armed">Click again…</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #e2e2dd; color: #141414; font: 650 12.5px 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: default; } .ds-btn:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #65655f; } .ds-btn.danger { color: #d92d20; } .ds-btn.armed { background: #d92d20; color: #fff; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Section Tabs
components.description: Storage section tabs over a 2px heading rule; the active tab is an ink fill.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid #0a0a0a; } .ds-tabs button { height: 32px; padding: 0 13px; border: none; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #65655f; font: 700 13.5px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tabs button.on { background: #141414; color: #fff; } .ds-tabs span { font-size: 12px; opacity: .7; }

components.name: Context Menu
components.description: Translucent blurred card; floats, so it casts a shadow.
components.css: .ds-menu { min-width: 200px; padding: 5px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: rgba(255,255,255,.94); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.6); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .5px #e2e2dd, 0 12px 34px rgba(20,20,20,.16); } .ds-menu button { text-align: left; border: none; background: transparent; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 13px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #141414; } .ds-menu button:hover { background: #141414; color: #fff; } .ds-menu .danger { color: #d92d20; } .ds-menu hr { border: none; height: 1px; background: #e2e2dd; margin: 4px 6px; }

components.name: Unused Badge
components.description: Small red-tinted badge for problems (Unused image, Overdue).
components.css: .ds-badge { padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #d92d20 12%, #fff); color: #d92d20; font: 700 12px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: dotMD lives in the world of its logo: black ink on white paper, with the 'you are here' moments peeled off as die-cut stickers. The writing sheet is a white page lifted off a warm-neutral ground; the chrome is the same ground, quiet and flat. Ink is the accent. This is an Operate surface, so the personality lives in a handful of precise details (sticker states, hand-cut corners, heavy titles, the blinking 'oo' eyes in empty states) while lists stay scanable and every view is keyboard-first.
keyCharacteristics: White paper sheet on a warm-neutral ground; flat chrome.
Ink is the accent: fills, active states, primary actions.
Stickers mark 'you are here': ink fill, white die-cut ring, soft lift, tilt, uneven corners.
Inter Variable everywhere; 800-weight tightly tracked titles; mono only for code.
Colour comes from content (subject swatches, tags, highlights) and danger.
Quick iOS-like motion: exponential ease-out, a small overshoot for pops.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: The accent is ink. A brand hue in chrome is a defect; colour belongs to content and to danger.

rules.name: The Fill vs Line Rule
rules.body: --accent is for fills, --accent-strong for text and lines; never set text in --accent.

rules.name: The Heavy Title Rule
rules.body: Titles are short, 800-weight and tightly tracked; everything beneath stays 600–700 at small sizes.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: Section labels are small, uppercase, letter-spaced, muted and ruled — never large.

rules.name: The Lift-Means-On-Top Rule
rules.body: Rows and cards don't cast shadows; only the page, stickers and floating things lift.

dos: Do use stickers only for 'you are here', one per group.
Do keep chrome ink-and-paper; let subjects, tags and highlights bring colour.
Do read every colour, radius and wash from its variable so presets keep working.
Do give every list view keyboard selection and stand its keys down while an overlay owns them.
Do make destructive actions undoable; reserve the two-click armed confirm for permanent deletes.
Do use tabular figures for sizes, counts and dates.
donts: Don't introduce a brand hue into chrome.
Don't add resting shadows to rows or cards.
Don't add confirm dialogs for recoverable actions.
Don't use mono as costume in chrome.
Don't hardcode hex in new UI (dark scrims excepted).
